author: Vincent Augerot
name: HardSlice condition of a recurring command
description: The condition of a command that AddRecurringCommand sends, new or existing: <Command>Condition in the folder of its slice, which implements IRecurringCommandCondition<<Command>Command> and decides before each cycle whether the command is sent, and its integration tests, which hold a cycle back with its reason and let one go. It prints the line that registers it after the handler, in the module. --response names what the command returns when it is not a Guid. Run it from the root of the solution with --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj.

Module.description: The module of the command, in PascalCase, such as Schedule: src/<App>/Features/<Module>/<Module>Module.cs must exist.

Command.description: The command slice that the condition decides on, by the name of its folder in PascalCase, without the Command suffix, such as ImportSchedule for ImportScheduleCommand: src/<App>/Features/<Module>/<Command>/ must hold <Command>.cs, where dotnet new hardslice-command declares the command, or <Command>Command.cs, and no <Command>Condition.cs yet.

Response.description: What the command returns, the second type argument of its AddRecurringCommand: id (a Guid, by default), none (a bool) or the PascalCase name of the DTO that its slice declares, such as ImportedScheduleDto.

postActions.description: Refuses a solution whose web project it cannot read.

manualInstructions.text: error: hardslice-condition reads the application from its web project, which it could not evaluate. Run it from the root of the solution with --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj, once the solution is restored (after a first build or check), such as: dotnet new hardslice-condition --project src/<App>/<App>.csproj --module <Module> --command <Command>. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a module name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --module 'ModuleName' is not PascalCase: pass the name of an existing module, such as the folder of src/MyApp/Features/<Module>/. Nothing was created.

manualInstructions.text: error: module 'ModuleName' does not exist: src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/ModuleNameModule.cs was not found. Pass the module of the command, the folder of src/MyApp/Features/<Module>/ that holds its slice. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a command name that is not PascalCase.

manualInstructions.text: error: --command 'CommandName' is not PascalCase: pass the name of the folder of the command slice, such as --command ImportSchedule. Nothing was created.

manualInstructions.text: error: --command 'CommandName' ends with Command or Condition: pass the name of the slice alone, the folder of src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/<Command>/, such as --command ImportSchedule for ImportScheduleCommand. The template names the condition <Command>Condition. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a solution whose Directory.Build.targets does not list the files of its slices.

manualInstructions.text: error: hardslice-condition reads the files of the slices from HardSliceSliceFiles, which Directory.Build.targets does not define: it comes from a template older than hardslice-condition. Directory.Build.targets is protected: a maintainer updates it with dotnet hardslice upgrade. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a slice that does not exist.

manualInstructions.text: error: slice 'CommandName' does not exist in module 'ModuleName': src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/CommandName/ holds no source file. Generate the command first with dotnet new hardslice-command --project src/MyApp/MyApp.csproj --module ModuleName --name CommandName and --every or --daily-at, or pass the folder of an existing command. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: Refuses a slice without the file of its command.

manualInstructions.text: error: the slice CommandName of module 'ModuleName' has no command file: neither src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/CommandName/CommandName.cs, where dotnet new hardslice-command declares CommandNameCommand, nor CommandNameCommand.cs exists. A condition decides on a command that AddRecurringCommand sends: pass the folder of that command. Nothing was created.

error: the command CommandNameCommand already has its condition: src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/CommandName/CommandNameCondition.cs exists. Add the new rule to that condition, or write a second IRecurringCommandCondition<CommandNameCommand> of another name in the same folder by hand: every condition registered for the command is checked before each send. Nothing was created.
error: --response 'ResponseOption' is neither id, none nor the PascalCase name of the DTO that the command returns, such as --response ImportedScheduleDto. Nothing was created.

postActions.description: The line to add to the module of the command.

manualInstructions.text:
Register the condition in src/MyApp/Features/ModuleName/ModuleNameModule.cs:
1. Add the usings that the file does not have yet:
using MyApp.Features.ModuleName.CommandName;
using MyApp.Shared.Messaging;
2. In AddModuleNameModule, register the condition by its contract, after the handler of CommandNameCommand:
            .AddScoped<IRecurringCommandCondition<CommandNameCommand>, CommandNameCondition>()
Until it is registered, ProgramTests fails and names it. AddRecurringCommand checks it before each send of CommandNameCommand: a command generated with --every or --daily-at is sent by it, and a command without parameter that keeps its endpoint gets its schedule by one more line after its handler, as the skill add-slice shows. Without it, the tests of the condition wait for a cycle that never comes and fail.
Then complete the condition and its tests: each TODO(hardslice): marker fails the check until it is replaced.
